items.t: Connecting rod bearings can fail and ruin the engine (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Engine shuts off while driving or at stops
items.job: Replace EVAP purge valve and diagnose stalling
items.note: Usually covered by the factory warranty on these years.

items.t: Door wiring corrosion can delay side airbags (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Windows open and parking brake applies on their own
items.job: Repair driver door wiring harness or door switch
items.note: Often handled under the door wiring recall or warranty.

items.t: Passenger airbag can switch off with an adult in the seat (recall)
items.note: Free at a VW dealer under the recall.

items.t: Sudden braking from the Front Assist system
items.job: Front Assist diagnosis, software update and sensor calibration
items.note: Usually done under warranty.

items.t: Brake squeal, grinding and early pad wear
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $436 for front pads; add rotors if worn.

items.t: Touchscreen freezes, reboots or goes blank
items.job: Infotainment software update or unit replacement
items.note: Software updates are usually free; a new unit is covered under warranty.

items.t: Backup camera can go black from an infotainment fault (recall)
